title: Free Independent Residencies (Spring)
host_org: Snow Farm: The New England Craft Program
source_quote: In April, the Free Independent Residency is held for experienced makers. Applications open early each year and qualified applicants will be entered into a drawing for the chance for a total of 6 open residency spots.
evidence_sentence: The free April independent residency for experienced makers includes access to all studios with raku, gas reduction, and pit firing.
evidence_quote: upgraded electricity for the outdoor kiln deck which includes a raku kiln, Bailey gas kiln, and pit firing area
summary: Six free residency spots available in April for experienced makers to work independently in any studio, including ceramics with atmospheric firing access.
how_to_join: Enter drawing (applications open early in the year)
